EN: I wish we had TV in here.
ZH: 我希望我们这里有电视。

EN: Sure wish I had a BB gun...
ZH: 真希望我有一把BB枪……

EN: I wonder if anyone in the Wasteland still makes comics...
ZH: 不知道废土上还有没有人画漫画……

EN: When I grow up, I'm going to explore the Wasteland!
ZH: 等我长大了，我要去探索废土！

EN: Someday I'll take the G.O.A.T. test and get to work!
ZH: 总有一天我要参加G.O.A.T.测试，然后去上班！

EN: Wish I was old enough to gamble in the casino.
ZH: 真希望我到了能进赌场赌两把的年纪。

EN: Who wants to play hide and seek?
ZH: 谁想玩捉迷藏？

EN: Sometimes I feel the Overseer... watching me.
ZH: 有时我觉得监督者……在盯着我看。

EN: Wonder if the cafeteria has any cookies.
ZH: 不知道餐厅是否还有饼干。

EN: The grown ups are always so busy!
ZH: 大人们总是那么忙碌！

EN: I wonder if I'll live in this Vault forever.
ZH: 我不知道我是否会永远生活在这个避难所里。

EN: Can you have a snowball fight during nuclear winter?
ZH: 核冬天的时候能打雪仗吗？

EN: When do I get a Pip-Boy?
ZH: 我什么时候能得到哔哔小子？

EN: Wonder what the weather's like outside.
ZH: 不知道外面的天气怎样。

EN: The Overseer is my hero!
ZH: 监督者是我的英雄！

EN: I've read Grognak #1 thirty seven times!
ZH: 《野蛮人古古那》第一部我读过三十七次！

EN: I wonder how many other Vaults are out there.
ZH: 我想知道外面还有多少别的避难所。

EN: Are there any kids out there in the Wasteland?
ZH: 废土上有小孩吗？

EN: My mom and dad are always so busy...
ZH: 我的爸爸妈妈总是那么忙……

EN: Snack time yet?
ZH: 还没到点心时间吗？

EN: Really wish I had a pet.
ZH: 真希望我有一个宠物。

EN: Maybe someone can build me a robot.
ZH: 也许有人能给我造一个机器人。

EN: I bet there are mutant hamsters out in the Wasteland.
ZH: 我敢打赌，废土上一定有变种仓鼠。

EN: My parents have the best jobs ever!
ZH: 我父母有最棒的工作！

EN: I want to have a sleepover tonight!
ZH: 我今晚想去朋友家过夜！

EN: The Vault is like a big, metal pillow fort!
ZH: 避难所就像一座大大的金属枕头堡垒！

EN: I bet I could make a sling shot. That would be so cool.
ZH: 我打赌我能自己做把弹弓。那肯定超酷。

EN: The Vault really needs some new toys.
ZH: 避难所真的需要一些新玩具。

EN: This is the best Vault ever!
ZH: 这是有史以来最好的避难所！

EN: Time for ice cream yet?
ZH: 吃冰淇淋的时间到了吗？

EN: My mom and dad really help keep this place running!
ZH: 多亏爸爸妈妈帮忙，这地方才能正常运转！

EN: Hey everybody! How's it going?
ZH: 嘿大家！最近怎么样？

EN: Anybody want to throw the ol' football around?
ZH: 有人想出来传传橄榄球吗？

EN: Do they play sports in the Wasteland?
ZH: 废土上的人也搞体育运动吗？

EN: Rock, paper, scissors... shoot!
ZH: 石头，剪刀，布！

EN: Help, there's a mutant in the Vault! Just kidding!
ZH: 救命啊，避难所里有变种人！——开玩笑的啦！

EN: No school, no babysitter - this is the life!
ZH: 没有学校，没有保姆——这才是生活！

EN: Hi everyone!
ZH: 哈喽大家好！

EN: I hope we have donuts for breakfast tomorrow.
ZH: 我希望明天的早餐是甜甜圈。

EN: I wish I had a chemistry set.
ZH: 真希望我能有一套化学实验玩具。

EN: I was thinking of hanging up some paintings.
ZH: 我想挂一些画上去。

EN: Think I should paint the room?
ZH: 你觉得我该粉刷房间了吗？

EN: You think that camera sees... everything?
ZH: 你觉得那个摄像头……什么都看得到吗？

EN: I think the room needs a rug. Maybe there's one in storage.
ZH: 房间需要地毯。也许储藏室里有一个。

EN: Home sweet home.
ZH: 家，甜蜜的家。

EN: I think that steam is making me lightheaded.
ZH: 蒸汽使我头昏眼花。

EN: Sometimes, I imagine this room is actually a giant mansion, on 50 acres.
ZH: 有时候，我会想象这个房间实际上是一个巨大的公馆，有50英亩那么大。

EN: The sofa needs repairs. I keep sinking into the cushions.
ZH: 沙发需要修理。我一直陷到垫子里。

EN: If we lived outside, I'd have servants.
ZH: 如果我们住在外面，我会有仆人。

EN: Want to play some cards?
ZH: 想玩牌吗？

EN: It's so good to have some free time to talk.
ZH: 有一些空闲时间可以聊天，真是太好了。

EN: Think we'll ever get to live outside the Vault?
ZH: 你有想过我们去避难所外面住吗？

EN: I wish we had some plants in here.
ZH: 我希望我们这里能有些植物。

EN: I'm too lazy to go to the Cardio Room. I wish we had a treadmill in here.
ZH: 我太懒了，不想去有氧运动室。真希望我们这里有一台跑步机。

EN: I need to remember to stock the fridge with Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 我得记住在冰箱里囤足够的核子可乐。

EN: My feet are killing me. I should probably sit down.
ZH: 我的脚好痛。我应该坐下来。

EN: I really wish we had a Mr. Handy.
ZH: 我真希望我们有一个巧手先生。

EN: Have you ever actually seen the Overseer?
ZH: 你是否真的见过监督者？

EN: If I started a Knitting League, think anyone would sign up?
ZH: 如果我成立一个编织队，你觉得会有人参加吗？

EN: I wish I had a yoga mat in here.
ZH: 我希望这里有一个瑜伽垫。

EN: Oh, good idea. Maybe cats. Or ships. Or cats on ships.
ZH: 哦，好主意。也许猫。也许船只。或者猫在船上。

EN: Maybe. But no yellow. I hate yellow.
ZH: 也许吧。但别用黄色。我讨厌黄色。

EN: I sure hope not!
ZH: 我当然希望不要！

EN: Good idea. My feet get so cold in the morning.
ZH: 好主意。早上我的脚很冷。

EN: If you say so.
ZH: 如果你这样说的话。

EN: You're imagining things. Then again, maybe that's because of the steam.
ZH: 你又瞎想了。不过话说回来，也许还真是蒸汽的缘故。

EN: Sometimes I imagine I'm not living with a crazy person.
ZH: 有时我会想象自己没有和一个疯子生活在一起。

EN: Maybe there's a new one in the Wasteland. Well, not a new one...
ZH: 也许废土上能弄到一个新的。呃，也不算新的……

EN: If you lived outside, you'd be dead.
ZH: 如果你住在外面，你就死了。

EN: Maybe later.
ZH: 也许待会儿吧。

EN: Actually, I just want to relax, so... Ssssshhhh.
ZH: 其实，我只是想休息一下，所以……嘘——

EN: Maybe. But why would you want to?
ZH: 也许吧。但你为什么想去？

EN: Maybe Hydroponics can grow some gardenias.
ZH: 也许可以水培一些栀子花。

EN: You... do see the irony in that statement. Don't you?
ZH: 你……该看出了那句话里的讽刺。对不对？

EN: And beer. Don't forget beer.
ZH: 还有啤酒。别忘了啤酒。

EN: Just please don't take off your shoes.
ZH: 请不要脱掉你的鞋子。

EN: Yeah, but a Mr. Gutsy would be way more fun.
ZH: 是的，但是打手先生会更有趣。

EN: No, but I do always get the sense that someone's watching me...
ZH: 没有，但我总是感觉有人在看着我……

EN: They'd be crazy not to!
ZH: 不参加才是疯了！

EN: A what now?
ZH: 什么玩意儿？

EN: Nothing like hanging out at home with my family.
ZH: 没有什么能比得上在家里和家人在一起。

EN: If I had the right plumbing, we would make great babies.
ZH: 要是我有合适的身体构造，我们准能生出超棒的宝宝。

EN: Too bad I can't make babies, because you're the cat's pajamas!
ZH: 可惜我没法生宝宝，你真是太有魅力了！

EN: You remind me of Jennifer. Sorry, gal, but my heart will always belong to her.
ZH: 你让我想起了珍妮佛。抱歉，姑娘，我的心永远属于她。

EN: The Vault is too crowded to have any more babies.
ZH: 避难所太拥挤了，无法容纳更多的婴儿。

EN: You look really nice.
ZH: 你看起来真的很美。

EN: I'm glad we got some time together.
ZH: 我很高兴我们有时间独处。

EN: I love talking to you.
ZH: 我喜欢和你说话。

EN: Finally some alone time.
ZH: 终于有独处的时间了。

EN: I've been thinking of you all day.
ZH: 我一整天都在想你。

EN: It's so great to see you.
ZH: 见到你真是太好了。

EN: I just love spending time with you.
ZH: 我就是喜欢和你待在一起。

EN: You always make me smile.
ZH: 你总能让我嘴角上扬。

EN: You're so sweet.
ZH: 你是如此的甜美。

EN: I don't know how I'd get by without you.
ZH: 我真不知道没有你我该怎么过。

EN: I think about you all the time!
ZH: 我每时每刻都在想你！

EN: You're the loveliest person I know.
ZH: 你是我的优乐美。

EN: If roses still grew, I'd search the Wasteland to get you some.
ZH: 如果玫瑰仍在生长，我会去废土上摘回来给你。

EN: I really think we could have a future together.
ZH: 我真的觉得我们可以有一个共同的未来。

EN: We make such a cute couple.
ZH: 我们会是很棒的一对！

EN: You're the apple of my eye.
ZH: 你是我的小呀小苹果。

EN: What would I do without you?
ZH: 没有你我会怎么办？

EN: You have beautiful eyes.
ZH: 你的眼睛很美。

EN: You make me feel like dancing.
ZH: 你让我感觉想要跳舞。

EN: If I could sing, I'd totally write a song about you.
ZH: 如果我能唱歌，我会写一首关于你的歌。

EN: I get butterflies whenever we're together.
ZH: 每当我们在一起，我心里就小鹿乱撞、怦怦直跳。

EN: I'd be so lonely here without you.
ZH: 没有你，我在这里一定很孤单。

EN: You're so attractive.
ZH: 你如此迷人。

EN: I find myself completely drawn to you.
ZH: 我发现自己完全被你吸引。

EN: If I could rearrange the alphabet, I'd put U and I together.
ZH: 如果我能重新排列字母表，我会把“U”和“I”放在一起。

EN: I'm not a photographer, but I can picture you and me together.
ZH: 我不是摄影师，但我能想象你和我在一起的画面。

EN: Do you have a map? I'm getting lost in your eyes.
ZH: 你有地图吗？我好像迷失在你眼神的海里。

EN: If I seem drunk, it's only because you're so intoxicating.
ZH: 如果我看起来喝醉了，那只是因为你是如此的令人陶醉。

EN: Are we in a vertibird? 'Cause my heart's taking off.
ZH: 我们是在一架飞鸟上吗？因为我的心好像起飞了。

EN: If I were a cat, I'd want to spend all 9 lives with you.
ZH: 如果我是猫，九条命我都想和你过。

EN: Is there a thief in the Vault? 'Cause you stole my heart.
ZH: 避难所里是不是有贼？因为我的心好像被偷走了。

EN: You must be a genie, because you're making my dreams come true.
ZH: 你一定是个精灵，因为你让我美梦成真。

EN: If love was radiation, I'd need a box of RadAway.
ZH: 如果爱是辐射，我可能需要一盒消辐宁。

EN: Seriously, could you get any cuter?
ZH: 讲真，你还能再可爱点吗？

EN: You're like cholesterol, always messin' with my heart.
ZH: 你就像胆固醇，总是扰乱我的小心脏。

EN: Did your father sell diamonds? 'Cause you are flawless.
ZH: 你的父亲是卖钻石的吗？因为你简直完美无瑕。

EN: I really want to kiss you right now.
ZH: 我想亲你。

EN: You think maybe... I could call you baby?
ZH: 你觉得……我能叫你宝贝吗？

EN: Being here with you makes me feel so... special.
ZH: 在这里和你在一起，让我感觉好……特别。

EN: It is getting warm in here, or is it just me?
ZH: 这里是不是越来越热了，还是只有我这么觉得？

EN: I must have died in that last Radroach attack, 'cause baby? I'm in Heaven.
ZH: 上次辐射蟑螂袭击的时候我八成已经死了——因为宝贝，我现在就跟在天堂一样！

EN: Sound the alarm! We've got a thief in the Vault! They stole my heart. Heh.
ZH: 警报！我们的避难所里有个贼！偷走了我的心。嘿嘿。

EN: If I could rearrange the alphabet, I'd put B and O together. No! Wait! That's not right...
ZH: 如果我能重新排列字母表，我会把“B”和“O”放在一起。不！等等！不对……

EN: Call the doctor! I'm having an infarction! That's a heart attack. Because you're so... Oh, never mind.
ZH: 快叫医生！我心肌梗塞了！就是心脏病发作那种。因为你实在太……哦，算了。

EN: Nuka-Cola's got nothin' on you, sugar.
ZH: 甜心，核子可乐也比不上你。

EN: Like an irradiated post-apocalyptic parasitic organism, you are under my skin.
ZH: 你就像一只受过辐射的后末日寄生生物，钻进我心里，怎么也摆脱不掉。

EN: Are you a book in the Vault library? 'Cause I am checking you out.
ZH: 你是避难所图书馆里的一本书吗？因为我想把你借走。

EN: Come here often? I mean, we're all trapped down here, so I assume yes, but still...
ZH: 经常来这儿？我是说，我们都被困在这里，所以应该是的，但还是……

EN: I'm a licensed Vault Suit inspector. I'm going to need to hug you VERY closely.
ZH: 我是一个有执照的避难所套装检查员。我需要紧紧地拥抱你。

EN: You have beautiful thighs. Eyes! I meant eyes! But your thighs are nice too...
ZH: 你的大腿真美。眼睛！我是说眼睛！不过你的大腿也很好看……

EN: Your teeth are so shiny and beautiful. Like a skeleton that's been picked clean.
ZH: 你的牙齿是那么闪亮和美丽。像一个被清理干净的骷髅。

EN: Is there a Yao Guai in the Vault? He must be looking for you, honey.
ZH: 避难所有一只妖怪熊吗？它一定在找你，亲爱的。

EN: I want to love you like this is my last day on Earth. Because it probably is.
ZH: 我想把今天当做世界末日一样去爱你。因为可能真的是。

EN: Are you swooning, or is that the radiation poisoning?
ZH: 你是神魂颠倒了，还是辐射中毒了？

EN: Is that a Raider setting off explosives or is my heart pounding?
ZH: 是掠夺者引爆了炸药还是我的心在狂跳？

EN: I think... I think I'm in like with you.
ZH: 我想……我想我是“喜欢”你，还谈不上“爱”。

EN: I could use a good kiss.
ZH: 我并不介意来一个不错的吻。

EN: You're like food poisoning - tying my stomach in knots.
ZH: 你就像食物中毒——搅得我胃里打结。

EN: Do you really like me?
ZH: 你真的喜欢我吗？

EN: I think Cupid just emptied his quiver...
ZH: 我想……丘比特刚刚把他的箭袋都射空了……

EN: Is that jumpsuit felt? Would you like it to be?
ZH: 你这身连身衣是毛毡做的吗？——你想让它变成毛毡吗？

EN: Do you have a watch? I think it's snuggle time.
ZH: 你有手表吗？我想依偎在一起的时间到了。

EN: Your lips. They're just so... smoochable.
ZH: 你的嘴唇。它们真是……太让人想亲了。

EN: I saw the doctor. He said my body's deficient... in vitamin U.
ZH: 我去看了医生。他说我身体缺乏……维生素U。

EN: You're so sweet, I'm getting a toothache.
ZH: 你是那么的甜美，甜得我牙痛。

EN: I hope another bomb goes off. I'd duck and cover with you anytime.
ZH: 我希望再来一枚炸弹。这样我随时都能和你一起躲起来。

EN: Are you this nice to all the Dwellers?
ZH: 你对所有的居民都这么好吗？

EN: I think we're having an earthquake, ‘cause I'm falling for you.
ZH: 我想一定发地震了，因为我正为你坠落。

EN: Can you get that for me? I dropped my jaw.
ZH: 能帮我捡一下吗？我的下巴掉地上了。

EN: You're like a broken thermostat. I just can't turn you down.
ZH: 你就像一个坏掉的温控器，我就是没法把你“调低”——也没法拒绝你。

EN: If kisses were snowflakes, well... you'd better get some boots, that's all I'm saying.
ZH: 如果亲吻是雪花，那么……你最好备双雪地靴。我就说这么多。

EN: Sometimes, late at night, I smell the sweat and steel... and know that you smell it too.
ZH: 有时，深夜里，我闻到了汗水和钢铁的气味……而且知道你也闻到了。

EN: Baby, who cares about the sun? I'm the only light you need.
ZH: 宝贝，谁关心太阳呀？我是你唯一需要的光。

EN: Sorry, I'm all out of raisins. But you can have a date.
ZH: 对不起，葡萄干我吃完了。不过，我可以给你一个约会——我是说，一颗椰枣。

EN: You're like a cute, chubby polar bear – always trying to break the ice.
ZH: 你就像一只可爱又胖乎乎的北极熊——总在试图破冰。

EN: Impressed? You will be.
ZH: 印象深刻吗？你马上就会了。

EN: Call for you. It's Heaven, wondering if you're coming home.
ZH: 有你的电话。是天堂打来的，问你是不是要回家了。

EN: So, what are you up to for the rest of your life?
ZH: 那么，你对未来的日子有什么打算？

EN: Is that love in the air, or is the oxygen circulator on the fritz again?
ZH: 空气里弥漫的是爱的味道，还是氧气循环器又坏了？

EN: Are you this nice to all the Dwellers?
ZH: 你对所有的居民都这么好吗？

EN: But this is biologically impossible!
ZH: 但生理上是不可能的！

EN: We can't start a family. There's no more room in the Vault.
ZH: 我们没法要孩子了，避难所里已经没有空房了。

EN: This room's useless unless we generate more power!
ZH: 除非我们多发点电，否则这房间就没法用了！

EN: We've gone dark! We need more power!
ZH: 房间黑了！我们需要更多的电！

EN: There isn't enough power! We need more!
ZH: 没有足够的电！我们需要更多！

EN: We can't use the room! There's not enough power!
ZH: 这房间用不了了！电不够！

EN: Oh no! Blackout! The room's offline until we get more power!
ZH: 哦不！停电了！得多弄点电来，这房间才能恢复运作！

EN: By myself. Outside the Vault. Oh, this'll end well.
ZH: 我一个人。在避难所外面。哦，这可够我受的了。

EN: So... lonely...
ZH: 好……寂寞……

EN: It's not the loneliness that gets ya. It's the being alone.
ZH: 寂寞没什么可怕，可怕的是你只有一个人。

EN: I swear, if I die alone, I'm going to be so mad...
ZH: 我发誓，如果我就这么孤零零地死了，真是做鬼都不得安宁……

EN: Doing this is one thing. Doing it alone? Ugh.
ZH: 任务是要完成的，但真的要一个人去吗？真是的。

EN: Sure wish I had some company.
ZH: 真希望能有个人陪陪我。

EN: Goin' it solo. Because apparently that's how I roll.
ZH: 一个人出发咯。没办法，我就这作风。

EN: “Forever Alone” - That'll be my autobiography.
ZH: “孤独终老”——我的自传就叫这个名。
